verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly describe metadata filtering with pre-filtering applied before vector search so filters narrow the candidate set rather than post-filtering top-k results, preserving recall/latency (lancedb-docs-41, lancedb-docs-5). Community evidence corroborates predicate pushdown for filters, an independent confirmation of the performance-conscious filtering design (lancedb-comm-2). Missing for 10: quantitative benchmarks showing recall/latency impact at scale, and more detailed docs on filter+ANN index interaction edge cases.
